Setup.Name: Traces playground
Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Processor Temperature"
    Description: "Reads raw payload data."
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/+/raw"
    Otel:
      Traces:
        - CreateSpans: 
          - Id: "4711"
            Name: "Start running"
            Parent: "MyParent"
            Kind: Server
            Status: Error
            Attributes: 
              - Key: "Hello"
                Value: "world"
            LinkTo:
              - Target: "4321"
        - EndSpans:
          - Id: "4711"
        - CreateEvents: 
          - SpanId: 4711
            Name: "Something happened"
          - SpanId: 1234
            Name: "Something else happened"
